not_covered.reason: needs a pressure rig and a destructive test, not a bench measurement
needs a cut section of the print; measure it from a sacrificial part

tests.instrument: Digital scale, 0.1 g resolution or better, calibrated with a known mass
tests.pass_rule: Pass when the measured value is <= 250 g.
procedure: Assemble the prototype as it will be deployed: hull, lid, electronics, battery, seals.
Zero the scale. Place the assembled prototype on it and wait for a stable reading.
Record the mass in grams. Repeat three times, removing the prototype each time.
Use the mean of the three readings as the measured mass.
tests.statement: The total mass of the pod shall not exceed 250 g.
tests.title: Mass of the assembled prototype

tests.instrument: Digital scale (0.1 g), vessel big enough to submerge the prototype, thermometer, hydrometer
tests.pass_rule: Pass when the measured value is >= -0.05 ratio.
procedure: Weigh the assembled, sealed prototype dry: total mass m in grams.
Fill the vessel with water and measure its density in g/cm3 (hydrometer).
Put the vessel on the scale and zero it. Push the prototype fully under water with a thin rod, without touching the vessel. Do not let it touch the bottom.
Read the scale: the added grams divided by the water density is the displaced volume V in cm3.
Compute margin = (V x density - m) / m. Repeat three times and use the mean.
Keep the prototype under water for 10 minutes and check the inside for leaks.
tests.statement: The pod shall stay near neutral buoyancy, with a buoyancy margin of at least -0.05.
tests.title: Buoyancy margin

tests.instrument: Calipers, 0.1 mm resolution; the printed hull and the real board and battery
tests.pass_rule: Pass when the measured value is = 1 ratio.
procedure: Measure the bay in the printed hull, and the board and the battery, in millimetres.
Place the board, then the battery, in the bay in the orientation used in the design. Check that nothing is forced and the lid closes.
Compare the sorted dimensions of each part with the sorted dimensions of the bay.
Record the result as 1 (both fit) or 0 (either does not), with the dimensions.
tests.statement: The electronics assembly shall fit the pod's electronics bay, which is sized for a sensor board of up to 60 mm.
tests.title: Electronics and battery fit the bay

tests.instrument: Calipers or steel ruler, 0.1 mm resolution; the printer's stated bed size
tests.pass_rule: Pass when the measured value is = 1 ratio.
procedure: Measure the printed hull's three bounding dimensions in millimetres. Do this on the printed part, not on the CAD file.
Sort the three dimensions and the three bed dimensions in ascending order.
The part fits if each sorted dimension is no larger than the matching bed dimension.
Record the result as 1 (fits) or 0 (does not fit), with the dimensions.
tests.statement: The pod shall fit within the print bed.
tests.title: Printed hull fits the print bed
